0022600132.text: Atlanta hosts Miami in the Hawks' fifth game of the season, with the Hawks at 2-2 and second in the Southeast, one game back, while the Heat are 0-4 on a four-game losing streak and fifth in the Southeast, three games back. Atlanta is 0-1 at home and 2-1 on the road and sits seventh in the East, while Miami is 0-3 at home, 0-1 on the road, and 15th in the East; the teams have not played each other yet this season, and the Heat beat the Hawks 143-117 in Miami on April 12 after the Hawks lost 1-3 in the 2025-26 season series. Atlanta is missing Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), and Aaron Wiggins is day-to-day with a knee bruise and a game-time decision, while Miami is without Simone Fontecchio (illness) and Pelle Larsson is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and a game-time decision.
